workplaces.name: counter
workplaces.description: A counter that every bot of a project shares: the tool `tick` adds one and says the total; it offers a table, a tree and a code view of its ticks.

workplaces.name: ghidra
workplaces.description: Reverse engineering with Ghidra: add a binary to the project and the person and the bots work on one analysis, with a tree of functions, the decompiled code, strings and imports.
